title: Orthogonal Model Merging
abstract: arXiv:2602.05943v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Merging finetuned Large Language Models (LLMs) has become increasingly important for integrating diverse capabilities into a single unified model. However, prevailing model merging methods rely on linear arithmetic in Euclidean space, which often destroys the intrinsic geometric properties of pretrained weights, such as hyperspherical energy. To address this, we propose Orthogonal Model Merging (OrthoMerge), a method that performs merging operations on the Riemannian manifold formed by the orthogonal group to preserve the geometric structure of the model's weights. By mapping task-specific orthogonal matrices learned by Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT) to the Lie algebra, OrthoMerge enables a principled yet efficient integration that takes into account both the direction and intensity of adaptations. translated_abstract: 合并微调后的大语言模型（LLMs）对于将多种能力整合到单一统一模型中正变得越来越重要。然而，主流的模型合并方法依赖于欧几里得空间中的线性算术运算，这往往会破坏预训练权重的内在几何属性，例如超球面能量。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了正交模型合并（OrthoMerge），一种在由正交群形成的黎曼流形上执行合并操作的方法，以保持模型权重的几何结构。通过将正交微调（OFT）学习到的任务特定正交矩阵映射到李代数，OrthoMerge 实现了一种有原则且高效的整合方式，能够同时考虑自适应的方向和强度。除了直接利用 OFT 得到的正交矩阵外，我们进一步将该方法扩展到使用非正交方式微调的通用模型。
tldr: 提出OrthoMerge方法，通过在正交群形成的黎曼流形上进行合并以保留预训练权重的几何结构，从而更有原则且高效地整合多个微调大语言模型的多样化能力。
